topic: Choose a standing desk for the team office

scenario.topic: Choose a standing desk for the team office
scenario.opening_question: What balance of cost, adjustability, and aesthetics matters most for our new standing desk?

options.name: Fully Electric Height Adjustable Desk
options.upside: Smooth and easy height adjustments with memory presets
options.tradeoff: Higher cost and requires power outlet nearby
options.concern: Potential noise from motor during adjustments
options.best_for: Users prioritizing convenience and frequent height changes

options.name: Manual Crank Adjustable Standing Desk
options.upside: Lower price and no electricity needed
options.tradeoff: Requires physical effort to adjust height
options.concern: Adjustment can be slow and inconvenient during busy workdays
options.best_for: Budget-conscious teams valuing reliability over convenience

options.name: Fixed Height Bamboo Standing Desk
options.upside: Eco-friendly materials and stylish natural look
options.tradeoff: No height adjustability, fixed at standing height
options.concern: May not fit all users’ ergonomic needs
options.best_for: Teams prioritizing sustainability and design over flexibility

options.name: Sit-Stand Converter Platform
options.upside: Lowest cost and easy to move between desks
options.tradeoff: Limited workspace and lower weight capacity
options.concern: May feel cramped and less stable for heavier equipment
options.best_for: Teams wanting a portable and affordable standing option

shared_context: Goal is to improve ergonomics and comfort during work hours

personas.background: I appreciate eco-friendly and stylish office furniture that fits well with our team's design ethos.

personas.private_goal: I want a fully electric height adjustable desk with smooth, memory preset adjustments for maximum ease of use.

C) Fixed Height Bamboo Standing Desk — cost: 250; assembly time: 30 minutes; weight capacity: 100 lbs (+ Eco-friendly materials and stylish natural look; − No height adjustability, fixed at standing height)
D) Sit-Stand Converter Platform — cost: 180; assembly time: 10 minutes; weight capacity: 35 lbs (+ Lowest cost and easy to move between desks; − Limited workspace and lower weight capacity)
